title: Derive plan duties from the resolved policy tools (not a label)
commit: refactor(dispatch): derive plan duties from policy tools, not agent names

derivations.separationComment: Recorded in worker-dispatcher.ts at the two suppression branches and the BuildSystemInstructionsOptions.resolvedTools docstring: suppression answers 'does this agent hold the tool', plan-mode answers 'is this agent plan duty'; deliberately decoupled.

suppression.rule: suppress memory section iff resolvedTools != null && !toolAllowed(resolvedTools,'vteam_memory_save'); artifact section iff resolvedTools != null && !toolAllowed(resolvedTools,'vteam_submit_artifact')
suppression.toolAllowedSemantics: allow/ask => allowed; deny/absent => not allowed (mirrors worker guard isToolAllowed)
suppression.nullSemantics: resolvedTools null/undefined => DO NOT suppress (legacy/unknown callers byte-identical)
suppression.singleResolution: resolveBoundaryCorrection refactored to resolveBoundaryAndTools returning {correction, tools}; dispatch resolves once and uses correction for the boundary section and tools for suppression
suppression.removed: BuildSystemInstructionsOptions.agentRole; the `opts?.agentRole ?? agent.role` fallback read; both isPlanRole() suppression calls

planMode.source: registered duty of the BOUND opencode agent via server/src/common/opencode-agent-duty.ts
planMode.taskEffectivePlanMode: tasks.service.ts: (task.planMode) || getOpencodeAgentDuty(members.find(id===mainMemberId)?.opencodeAgentName ?? null)==='plan' (already duty-based; no name literal; unchanged)

threeLiterals.resolveTaskEffect: server/src/execution-policies/execution-policy.service.ts:312-315 -> stored valid value wins, else getOpencodeAgentDuty(name)==='plan' ? 'allow':'deny'

gate.singleSource: server/src/common/opencode-agent-duty.ts -> export const VTEAM_PLAN_AGENT_NAME = 'vteam-plan'; PLAN_DUTY_AGENTS built from it (plus 'plan','prometheus')
gate.wireBytes: unchanged: the dispatch candidate value is still the literal string 'vteam-plan' (worker guard only maps the literal); only its SOURCE moved to the duty registry

D3_plannerMember.new: teamMember.findMany({where:{teamId},orderBy:[{seq:'asc'},{id:'asc'}],select:{id:true,agent:{select:{agentKey:true,role:true}}}}) then .find(member => getOpencodeAgentDuty(`vteam-${member.agent.agentKey ?? member.agent.role}`)==='plan'); no match => null (fail-open, unchanged)

D4_planDocsRequester.new: resolvePlanAgentId(): prisma.agent.findMany({select:{id,agentKey,role}}) then first whose `vteam-<agentKey ?? role>` has plan duty (or name===VTEAM_PLAN_AGENT_NAME) -> its id; unresolvable => warn + skip gate consult (fail-open, no forged identity)

intentionalSemanticChange.description: A resolved policy whose `tools` lacks `vteam_memory_save` / `vteam_submit_artifact` now suppresses the respective section even for a NON-planner, and an agent that holds them no longer has them suppressed even if it is a planner. This is the plan's stated intent ('suppress exactly when the allowlist lacks the tool'). Seeded members are covered by todo 9's BEFORE/AFTER proof.
intentionalSemanticChange.seededSafety: All 7 built-in toolAllows already lacked vteam_memory_save for vteam-plan only and held it for the other 6; artifact likewise. Suppression output for seeded members is unchanged.
